_about: The weekly report's written text, by the Saturday review (scripts/README.md). build.py lays out what is here and leaves out any part that is missing or empty. Text may use bold and italic. Never type a figure that the database gives (cash, profit, the lowest point, next orders, route profit, growth signals, hubs first, markets): build.py prints those from results.json. Airlines in 'rivals' are keyed by their code (or their name). Every text below is an example of the format, not a real week.
week_line: Example: one sentence on the week, written by the Saturday review, for example where growth is coming from and what limits it.
what_matters: Example headline. A point the CEO should know, with its source: a market, a base, a rival's move.
Another headline. Each point is a short paragraph; the figures behind it are in the tables that follow.

decisions.recommendation: What we recommend, in one or two sentences, and why.
Each decision has its own brief in docs/briefs/; this is the summary.

performance.title: Example: a one-line headline for the money page.
notes: What sits behind a number. For example a payment day or a refit that explains a dip in profit.

network.title: Example: a one-line headline for the network page.
notes: Planning: how the week's aircraft were planned, and anything the routes' loads say.

markets.title: Example: a one-line headline for the markets page.

why.Intra-Europe: Example: why this market matters to us.

notes: Example: a note under the markets tables.

hubs.title: Example: a one-line headline for the hubs page.
notes: Example: a note under the hubs and rivals.

rivals.AW: Example read: who Pan Am meets on its routes, and what that means.

moves.move: Opened a route or a base

risks.title: Example: the biggest risk this week, in one line.

rows.risk: Example risk. What could go wrong, with its source.

opportunities.title: Example: the best opportunity this week, in one line.

plan.title: Example: how the plan went this week, in one line.
done: Fleet: example of what we did this week.

rotation.moves: The moves made this week (big market, frequency, feeder)

watch: Example: something to watch next week.

method: Example: any note on method for this week.
